riskFlags.adjacent-execution: Execution occurs on an additional protocol, layer, or service.
riskFlags.bridge-or-route-trust: Inspect the selected route, asset provenance, and trust assumptions.
riskFlags.custody-model: Confirm who can control or recover assets and keys.
riskFlags.execution-ordering: Ordering, inclusion, or landing behavior is product-specific.
riskFlags.leverage-oracle-liquidation: Leverage, oracle, and liquidation mechanics can compound losses.
riskFlags.liquidity-and-exit: Depth, withdrawal, maturity, and exit behavior require product-level review.
riskFlags.methodology-not-endorsement: A label, score, verification, or dataset is not an endorsement.
riskFlags.privacy-boundary: Shielded, transparent, and viewing-key behavior must be confirmed.
riskFlags.service-provider-dependency: Availability or completeness depends on an off-chain provider.
riskFlags.smart-contract-risk: Contract behavior, upgrades, dependencies, and admin controls require review.
riskFlags.availability-not-production: The cited surface is announced, testnet-only, or otherwise not production.
